narrative.overview: The question is the page. One line of text lives at two scales: a large field on a blank sheet, then the header above its answer. Everything else is typeset under it like a medicine leaflet. The page has no boxes, no cards, no thread and no shell. Hierarchy comes from size, weight and space. The page is one column, 38rem wide, left-aligned, and light only.
keyCharacteristics: White ground, cool near-black ink, two greys, one petrol accent, one pale wash.
One sans family. Mono only for code spans (file names, tool names).
Rows and rules, not containers. The only filled shapes are the caution badge and the cited quote.
The text caret is the focus mark of the question field.
Motion is one shared-element move, one slow pulse, and short fades. All of it stops under prefers-reduced-motion.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Petrol marks only three things: where the reader is (caret, focus, active step), where a claim comes from (citation numerals), and where to take care (caution badges, "ambiguous", .flag). It is not used for decoration or for buttons as fills.

rules.name: The No Second Accent Rule
rules.body: Failure, refusal and caution use petrol, not red or amber. A failed step is a hollow petrol ring. The cue is carried by text as well as colour.

rules.name: The Weight 550 Rule
rules.body: Emphasis is weight 550 against 400. No bold (700) anywhere; 600 is reserved for numerals and the small section headings.

rules.name: The Mono Is Data Rule
rules.body: Monospace marks a file name, a tool name or a line range. It is never used for mood.

dos: Do use one column at 38rem and left-align everything.
Do make hierarchy with size, weight (400 / 550) and space.
Do use petrol only for position, provenance and care (see The One Voice Rule).
Do keep Ink 3 off the wash fill.
Do pair state colour with a text cue, as the step rows do with their summary text.
Do keep a visible focus ring (2px petrol, 3px offset) on every control except the question field, whose caret is the focus mark.
Do switch views by data-view on body and state by data-state on the step.
donts: Don't wrap content in cards, panels, bordered boxes or a chat thread.
Don't add a second accent colour, or a red for errors.
Don't add shadows, gradients or blur.
Don't use bold (700) or all-caps small labels above headings.
Don't use mono for anything but data.
Don't add a dark theme or a fallback from the stream to /ask (both listed as not built in the surface brief).
